egress.terms: The vendor homepage states that ordinary users can download shared files under 100M through a share link without logging in, and that VIP users have no file-size limit on login-free shared downloads. It also states that ordinary-user upload and download speed is never limited.

chaining: 2 TB per verified account, expiring in 12 months. So treat as '2 TB renewable annually per identity', not a permanent tier. 10 GB/file is the classic-Lanzou escape (classic caps at 100 MB).

extras.agent_focus: systematic GitHub keyword sweep (EN + zh-CN + ja + ru) for projects that advertise free/unlimited storage, used as a discovery net to surface named providers and wrappers not yet in the corpus

binding_note: the per-object cap sets the shard size and therefore the object count; it bounds the total more tightly than any headline quota
